settings.body: Naturally grounded. Heel-to-floor contact for proprioceptive feedback, mid-foot vent for airflow, and the barefoot feel your practice demands — with 360° grip where it matters most.

settings.title: Every Open Sole Style
settings.body: Open heel, mid-foot vent, full-contact grip. Choose your colorway.

settings.question: What makes Open Sole different from Closed Sole?
settings.answer: Coverage and feel — that's the whole difference. Open Sole leaves the heel exposed with a mid-foot breathing hole for a more grounded, barefoot feel and natural toe splay. Closed Sole has the heel and foot fully covered. Both perform identically — same grip, same stability. Choice is preference and feel only.

settings.question: Best grippy shoes for yoga and heated studios
settings.answer: Open Sole's vented mid-foot and heel-to-floor design keep you cool and grounded through transitions, balances, and sustained holds — in any temperature studio.

settings.question: Open Sole grippy shoes for mat Pilates
settings.answer: Open Sole leaves the heel exposed so it reads the surface directly, while injection-molded 360° grip locks through every roll-up and teaser. Closed Sole holds exactly the same on mat — both perform identically. Choice is preference and feel only.

settings.question: How should Open Sole fit?
settings.answer: Snug but not compressed. The open-heel design means less material at the back — size up if you're between sizes. The performance knit molds to your foot within 2–3 sessions.
